Red Cross in numbers

For over 150 years, we've been bringing hope and relief to communities in need.

1.4 million people

supported worldwide with life‑saving humanitarian assistance.

1,300 UK crises

supported by our UK crisis and emergency response team.

£7.5 million saved

by the NHS thanks to our UK health and care work.

We are the British Red Cross

Whether lives have been turned upside down by conflict, disaster, hardship or displacement – we're here to help people through it. Find out more.

  • Founded in 1870

    We’ve earned our reputation as one of the most trusted humanitarian charities in the UK by protecting people at every stage of a crisis.

  • Neutral and impartial

    As an independent UK charity, we work alongside the government to deliver humanitarian services where they’re needed most.

  • Working together

    We’re proud to be part of the International Red Cross and Red Crescent Movement, responding to humanitarian crises worldwide.
